import copy,json; from work import evaluate
req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'b':{'y':2,'x':1},'a':[1,2]}}; pol={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}; ev=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':[2]},'conditions':{'a':[1,2],'b':{'x':1,'y':2}},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':{'y':[2],'x':1},'conditions':{'a':[1,2],'b':{'x':1,'y':2}},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':req['conditions'],'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},{'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':req['conditions']}]; before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); assert evaluate(req,ev,pol)=={'status':'supported','value':{'y':[2],'x':1},'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}; assert (req,ev,pol)==before; assert evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},ev,pol)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']}; conflict=[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':req['conditions'],'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':req['conditions'],'verified':True}]; assert evaluate(req,conflict,pol)=={'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}; assert evaluate({'claim':'none','conditions':req['conditions']},ev,pol)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}; assert evaluate({'claim':'f','conditions':{}},[{'source':'s','claim':'f','value':False,'conditions':{}}],{'required_conditions':[]})=={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]}; requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]; print('all checks passed')
